environment: API35 arm64 emulator, two clients in one app UID, real Tor
sampling: Single warm instrumentation process, two isolated clients; PSS samples after five connected-idle seconds and during transfer. Not a physical-phone or battery measurement.
cold_start_method: Three am start -W TotalTime samples, force-stop between launches; signed minified release; existing synthetic identity/history; Tor starts asynchronously. Not time to network readiness.
measurement_stage: Tor-only M16 debug instrumentation before the final Join-dialog keyboard correction; not a final minified-release network benchmark.
